quarterly_data.signal: Demand outlook tied to AI infrastructure (section II-7): the construction unit says its hi-tech business can grow long term around data centers, with orders coming from domestic IT majors and, more recently, rising investment by foreign cloud service providers, and that North American and European demand for data centers, advanced manufacturing plants and smart logistics is expanding as AI and digital transformation accelerate. The power and energy business notes that AI and hyperscale data-center expansion is lifting electricity demand, sustaining investment in nuclear and LNG generation and making small modular reactors a mid-term growth field, while AI data-center growth is driving energy storage system demand and therefore battery-material demand.

Power generation and LNG assets: POSCO International runs the Incheon LNG combined-cycle plant with 3,412MW of capacity, about 9% of the capital region's installed base; H1 2026 output was 5,177 GWh at 55.93% utilisation. The Gwangyang LNG terminal has six tanks today and two more are being added by end-2026. Long-term LNG supply is contracted with Tangguh LNG, with POSCO International Singapore for 15 years from November 2026 on a Henry Hub-linked price, and with QatarEnergy Trading for four years from 2027 to 2030 on a Brent-linked price; POSCO also holds an exclusive 16-year Gwangyang terminal use contract running 09-01-2025 to 08-31-2041.
quarterly_data.figure: Incheon LNG CC 3,412MW; H1 output 5,177 GWh; utilisation 55.93%

quarterly_data.signal: Raw-material prices and capex: Q2 2026 iron ore averaged USD 95 per tonne (down about 2% QoQ), coking coal USD 238 per tonne (up 2%), scrap USD 394 per tonne (up 12%) and nickel USD 18,131 per tonne (up 4%). quarterly_data.signal: Battery materials and IT subsidiaries: POSCO Future M reported H1 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1,436,972M and operating profit of KRW 44,388M, and states that surging energy storage demand from AI data-center investment is sharply raising anode-material requirements, prompting expansion of spherical graphite capacity at the Saemangeum industrial complex and construction of an artificial graphite anode plant in Vietnam. POSCO DX posted H1 revenue of KRW 474,090,999 thousand and operating profit of KRW 13,518,928 thousand, and expects data-center systems to be the core growth driver of a KRW 42.1 trillion Korean ICT market in 2026; its 2025-26 R&D includes an NVIDIA Omniverse and Cosmos proof of concept, an AI Operator platform and an LLM NPU-based AX Edge solution.

quarterly_data.signal: Customers, tariffs and portfolio actions: principal H1 2026 steel customers are disclosed as the HD Hyundai (Hyundai Heavy Industries) group at 3%, the Hyundai Motor and Kia group at 3% and KG Steel at 2% of sales; domestic-to-export split is about 54:46. Note 37 records that the United States has applied a 50% tariff on all steel and aluminium products since 06-04-2025 and that the European Union cut steel import quotas and raised the above-quota tariff to 50% from July 2026. After the reporting date, on 08-07-2026 the board approved the sale of 36,434,963 POSCO International shares (about 20.71%) at KRW 55,400 each and 23,385,917 POSCO DX shares (about 15.38%) at KRW 20,600 each.
